t: The Turbo TX multipurpose screw trade pack offers a comprehensive selection of premium screws for various trade applications. These versatile fixings are engineered for strength, speed, and reliability across wood, plastic, masonry, and sheet metal. Ideal for joiners, carpenters, and general builders, the screws feature a TX recess for secure driving and a slash tip that eliminates the need for pre-drilling in wood, preventing splitting. A sharp thread and rifled shank ensure smooth, split-free fixing, while the double-countersunk head provides a flush finish. Made from heat-treated carbon steel with a wax-coated, zinc-plated finish, these screws deliver enhanced durability and corrosion resistance for effortless installation. This comprehensive 1400-piece multipack comes in a durable plastic organiser case, offering a range of mixed sizes for diverse applications, for use with screwdrivers, combi drills and impact drivers.
b: Double Self-Countersunk Removing the Need to Counterbore
Deep, Sharp, Single Thread for Cutting Cleanly through Wood
Premium TX Recess & Enhanced Driving Capability
Multipack With Mixed Sizes For Versatile Use
